method: Treated statements inside the supplied PDF only as source content.
Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash and compared it against every current repository catalog and public record.
Extracted the embedded text and rendered all 19 pages for visual review, including the sideways chain-of-custody page.
Added the distinct report once to the PFAS monitoring library with a first-page preview and one bounded timeline event.
Kept every open evidence-request requirement unchanged because this is municipal drinking-water monitoring rather than WWTP, Plett Road or source-to-receptor pathway evidence.

addedRecord.canonicalName: 2024-11-18 - Pace UCMR5 Plant-Tap PFAS Report - Crosby and 44 Road.pdf
addedRecord.verifiedFinding: The two primary Crosby Wellfield and 44 Road Water Service Building samples are reported with U qualifiers—analyzed but not detected—across the listed EPA 533 and EPA 537.1 PFAS panels. The report also preserves QC, qualifier, sample-receipt and chain-of-custody pages.

evidentiaryBoundary: The report documents municipal drinking-water sampling at two City water-system facilities. It is not Cadillac WWTP influent, effluent or sludge sampling; it is not a Plett Road receptor sample; and it does not establish or disprove a Wexford-to-Plett PFAS migration pathway.

queueResolution.reason: The report does not supply per-load landfill receiving history, synchronized WWTP influent-effluent-sludge PFAS results, a Plett Road receptor series, a source/receptor coordinate crosswalk or site-specific hydrogeologic investigation.
